messages:
ben: Heads-up — profiled a regression on production queueing / batching metrics this morning. Token-level tail latency jumped ~18% after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak.

maria: ugh. which selector change? the heuristic weights?

ben: yeah. changed kernel-scorer to prefer smaller kernels for short sequences, added a small penalty for memory copy. It helped p50 but seems to increase p99 when batch sizes are low.

kai: do we have batch-size histograms around the affected routes? my hunch: optimizer caused more kernel handoffs mid-batch -> extra copy + context switch.

ben: I pulled the queue sampler traces. Here's a quick prom query I've been eyeballing: 

```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(runtime_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
sum(rate(queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)
```

maria: can you paste one example route? customer-api/chat has a weird spike at 04:12 UTC.

ben: pasted snapshot: batch_size histogram shifted left (more 1-2 token batches), queue_wait p95 up from 18ms -> 34ms, token_decode p99 up 120ms.

ashley: we should add kvcache hit-rate per-prefix to the dashboard. missing KV hits will blow up effective seq length and bias kernel choice.

kai: +1. also surface kernel-handoff counter and last-chosen-kernel label on per-route timeline. helps correlate handoffs -> latency jumps.

ben: logged a tiny grep of profiler (NVIDIA/CPU mixed):

```
# simplified timeline
0.0000 init
0.0021 enqueue
0.0030 kernel_select (fast-kernel)  -> 0.0025
0.0065 kv_cache_miss -> refill (0.0035)
0.0150 kernel_copy
0.1350 decode_tokens (tail)
```

maria: decode_tokens jump looks large. is that decode or blocking on memcopy? kernel_copy shows 120us but decode_tokens is 120ms.

ben: right — the kernel choice forced a slower decode path (fallback path that isn't optimized for continuous-batching) when batch sizes < 4. We missed that interaction in unit tests.

deploy-bot: deploy #release/23.4 -> prod completed 02:50 UTC :white_check_mark:

ashley: actionables I'm taking: add metrics: `kvcache_hit_rate{route,prefix}`, `kernel_handoff_count{route,kernel_from,kernel_to}`, `batch_shape_histogram{route}`, and a derived `scheduler_efficiency = served_tokens / cpu_ms` per-route. Will wire up panel and alert if scheduler_efficiency drops >20% over 10m.

kai: i'll add an instrumentation flag to emit chosen_kernel in the request trace so we can join traces -> metrics for a week. Also will add an A/B to revert kernel-scorer change on 10% of traffic for comparison.

ben: patch proposal: revert penalty-for-memory-copy and instead introduce a dynamic kernel-threshold: prefer small kernels only when predicted batch_size >= 4. This uses recent batch_shape_histogram.

maria: agree. also add a regression test in perf-suite that simulates low-batch short-seq workload and checks p99 token latency doesn't regress >5%.

ashley: putting dashboard PR + alert rules this morning. will add an example panel that shows side-by-side: batch_size histogram, kv-hit-rate, kernel_handoffs, scheduler_efficiency.

ben: thanks. if we can get the chosen_kernel tracing + kvcache-per-prefix in the next 6 hours we can validate before EOD.

maria: i'll coordinate with SRE to silence noisy alerts while we iterate.

kai: will post test run later with the A/B metrics.

ben: cool. tagging @oncall in case any regressions pop up. :thumbsup:
